_note: EXOTIC colour seed lists, grouped by origin/type. An off-default armour colour that matches one of these is tagged with that family (high confidence). Anything off-default that matches NO known dye (see known-dyes.json) and NO family here is still flagged exotic, just as generic 'EXOTIC'. Hex codes are lowercase, no '#'. PURE is exhaustive. CRAFTED/TRUE_BLACK lists real documented values; OG_DYED/GLITCHED are intentionally open (those are defined by being off-default & not a known dye, not by a fixed chart). Expand freely.

_familyInfo.PURE: Perfect RGB extremes (e.g. #000000, #ff0000). Impossible via normal dyeing — always exotic.
_familyInfo.TRUE_BLACK: Crafted Necron/Storm pieces that stayed near-black on Floor 7 release day. Extremely valuable.
_familyInfo.CRAFTED: Colour retained from a crafting ingredient (e.g. early yellow Shark/Sharp pieces).
_familyInfo.OG_DYED: Dyed before Nov 2019 with the vanilla dye method — colours unreachable by Crystal/Fairy. The classic exotics (Magma, Lapis, Dragon sets, Tarantula, etc.).
_familyInfo.GLITCHED: Colour carried over through an armour-upgrade glitch.
